title: Analysis For Business Decisions
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a future occurrence for which the decision maker has no control over."
A state of nature is a future occurrence for which the decision maker has no control over.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a choice which is arrived at after considering all alternatives available given an assumed future state of nature."
The decision itself is a choice which is arrived at after considering all alternatives available given an assumed future state of nature.

Scheduling refers to establishing the timing of the use of equipment, facilities and human activities in an organization, that is, it deals with the timing of operations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to sequence two or more jobs in two different machines or work centres in the same order."
Johnson's rule is used to sequence two or more jobs in two different machines or work centres in the same order.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a scientific approach to problem solving for executive management (Wagner, 1973)."
Operations research is a scientific approach to problem solving for executive management (Wagner, 1973).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most widely applied techniques of operations research in business, industry and numerous other fields."
Linear programming is one of the most widely applied techniques of operations research in business, industry and numerous other fields.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the time between placing the order and receipt of material to the stock."

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a combination of various activities."
A project is a combination of various activities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means for selecting the order in which jobs should be done (processed)."
Priority rules provide means for selecting the order in which jobs should be done (processed).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a reactive form of control."
The feedback is a reactive form of control.
